fromDate.description: Inclusive start of the requested analytics period.

toDate.description: Inclusive end of the requested analytics period.

language.description: Language used to scope Search Analytics. Required for overview queries and filter-option discovery.

currency.description: Optional currency used to scope Search Analytics.

channel.description: Optional channel used to scope Search Analytics.

subChannel.description: Optional subchannel. It is ignored when channel is omitted.

classifications.description: Optional classification key/value filters. Keys are matched using Search Analytics classification semantics.

description: Date range and optional filters for a side-effect-free Search Analytics query.
